source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: Event Companion errata and rulings covering the Mission Deck from Chapter Approved. Warhammer Event Missions use no card amendments. Rulings: VP gained when the battle ends are not capped by the 15VP limit for each battle round, because the close of the battle is a separate moment from the close of round five. Taking away an operation marker that a mission action placed also ends the status that action gave (such as decoyed). You may take operation markers off the battlefield only as your Primary Mission card allows; if it is silent, they stay. Death Trap: the terrain area need not already be trapped when the enemy unit dies. Surveil the Foe: a unit surveilled while within range of a marked objective (one holding an operation marker) still counts if you remove that marker later in the same turn. Vital Link: with several central objectives, cumulative VP count for markers in any central objective you control. Plunder: “not within your territory” refers to the terrain area. Beacon: if the chosen Beacon unit dies before you achieve the card, you cannot pick another and the card cannot be achieved, so consider discarding it in your turn, which gains you 1CP.
